programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Em 2018, o Audi R8 Quattro Performance recebeu uma atualização. A nova versão compartilhou algumas de suas características aerodinâmicas com o Lamborghini Huracan. Além disso: o Porsche Macan S tem um motor mais potente.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Er ist kein gewöhnlicher Mitsubishi Outlander. Er ist das erste Plug-In Hybrid SUV der Welt. Sein neuartiger Antrieb besteht aus zwei Elektromotoren und einem 2-Liter Benziner. 4x4 Das Allradmagazin testet, ob ein Hybrid im Gelände überhaupt Sinn macht. Außerdem: Der amerikanische Full-Size-Pickup schlechthin: der Chevrolet Silverado. V8-Maschine, 3,5 Tonnen Leergewicht und mindestens 15 Liter Durchschnittsverbrauch. Doch dieser hier kann auch sparen - dank Erdgas!

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O renascimento do chique francês: o elegante DS 9 da marca de luxo Citroën. Além disso: o Genesis GV80 oferece luxo a um preço acessível. E: um test drive no exorbitantemente custoso Mercedes-Benz 300 SL.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Bentley und Jaguar sind bisher noch nicht als Produzenten klassischer SUVs in Erscheinung getreten. Das scheinen diese Hersteller ändern zu wollen. Sie stellen jetzt Konzepte für Luxus-Geländewagen vor. Überflüssig? Nicht konkurrenzfähig? Oder sogar besser als die anderen? Ein Ende des SUV-Booms ist nicht abzusehen, und so ist es ein logischer Schritt auch für die beiden britischen Edel-Marken, höhere Sitzposition anzubieten. Ein Highlight: Das Land Rover Discovery Vision Concept wartet mit einer durchsichtigen Motorhaube auf. Wie die Zukunft am SUV Markt aussehen kann, zeigt 4x4 Das Allradmagazin.

programme.title: Saab 93 e Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: Em 1937, foi fundada na Suécia uma empresa fabricante de aviões que mais tarde se tornou a famosa fabricante de automóveis Saab. Apresentamos dois de seus modelos icônicos de carros, o Saab 93 e o 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Os cupês britânicos são os clássicos nesta classe de veículos, estes carros são tão legais quanto James Bond. Aston Martin, Bentley e Jaguar produzem os cupês mais exclusivos e elegantes do mundo. Seu design distinto ainda é inspirado no icônico Jaguar E-Type e Aston Martin DB5. A DreamCars apresenta os mais exclusivos e caros cupês britânicos.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Nissan X-Trail und BMW X4: Nach Offroadern aus dem Bilderbuch schauen diese SUV nicht gerade aus. Mit Allradantrieb, starken Selbstzündern und sehr unterschiedlichen Preisen passen sie sich aber den Lebensverhältnissen vieler Menschen an. Nissan stellt die 3. Generation des X-Trail vor, und der X4 feiert in Bilbao Weltpremiere. Motorvision stellt die unterschiedlichen Konzepte vor. Außerdem: Die Steinbeißer- Trophy: Verrückte Allrad-Gefährte auf einer außergewöhnlichen Rallye.

programme.title: Maserati Gran Turismo Coupe Stradale
programme.desc: Assumir riscos e precisão é o que um jogador de pôquer precisa ter. O que isso tem a ver com o Maserati Gran Turismo Coupe Stradale? Ele combina ambas as características de uma forma surpreendente.

programme.title: BMW X4 Roadtrip, South Carolina
programme.desc: Wir dürfen heute den neuen BMW X4 fahren, das dürfen wir in South Carolina in den USA, und warum prasentiert BMW den hier? Weil er hier in Spartanburg im mittlerweile größten BMW Werk der Welt gebaut wird. Hier kommen alle X-Modelle her und wenn wir schon so weit rei-sen, dann will ich natürlich auch sehen wie dieses Auto gebaut wird,

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Design vanguardista, tecnologia superior e prazer de dirigir. Seja o Porsche 911, o Mercedes S-Class Coupe, o BMW série 6 ou o Audi RS5, os coupes alemães estão entre os carros mais excitantes do mundo. Com seus motores potentes, chassis esportivos e tecnologia avançada, eles incorporam a paixão pela direção. A DreamCars apresenta os coupes alemães mais bonitos e rápidos.

programme.title: Cayenne GTS wieder mit V8 - Beendet Porsche den Downsizing-Trend?
programme.desc: Nach den Rallye-Sportwagen 904, 924, 928 war der Cayenne 2007 der vierte Porsche mit den drei legendaren Buchstaben am Heck: GTS. Sie stehen für einen besonders sportlichen Auftritt, der auch bei Cayenne-Generation Nummer drei nicht fehlen darf. Große Überraschung: Die Rückkehr vom V6 zum V8. Erklart Porsche damit dem Downsizing-Trend das Ende? Und wo positionieren sich Cayenne GTS und Cayenne GTS Coupe in der großen Modellpalette?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Bei manchen Autos ist die erste Modellgeneration so überzeugend, dass sich eine zweite geradezu aufdrängt. Wir haben den Nissan Qashqai, Volvo XC70 und Suzuki Sx4 S-Cross unter die Lupe genommen um zu sehen, wo die Neuauflage gelungen ist.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Eles são a encarnação de um carro esportivo, os cupês de Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati e Alfa Romeo são de tirar o fôlego e irresistíveis. Criados pelos designers mais famosos do mundo, todo carro esportivo italiano é uma obra de arte. Quer seja um 8 ou 12 cilindros, cada motor é uma obra de arte. DreamCars apresenta os mais fascinantes cupês italianos, como o Ferrari 488 e FF, o Lamborghini Huracan e Aventador e o Maserati Gran Coupe.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Chiptuning verspricht mehr Leistung bei weniger Kraftstoffverbrauch. Wir prüfen bei zwei baugleichen BMWs die Auswirkungen dieser Manipulation. Außerdem: Verbessert die SkyActiv-Technologie die Effizienz des Mazda 3? Und: Stoßdämpfer von Koni.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: São os carros mais excitantes do mundo e incitam mais desejo do que qualquer outro carro, cupês internacionais da Maserati, Porsche, Bentley, Mercedes e Rolls Royce. Com seu design extraordinário e motores poderosos, os coupes evocam mais emoções do que qualquer outro carro. Eles são o epítome da elegância e exclusividade na fabricação de automóveis. DreamCars mostra os mais deslumbrantes cupês de sonho.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Der Dacia Logan MCV ist ein sehr günstiger Kombi. Wir haben den Logan und den Golf Variant, die Kleinwagen Audi A1 quattro und Renault Clio R.S. und die koreanischen SUVs SsangYong Rexton und Hyundai Santa Fe einem Billig-gegen-Teuer-Vergleich unterzogen.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Você quer se sentir como um piloto de corrida sem estar limitado a uma pista de corrida? Se sim, o fabricante britânico Radical é a escolha certa, já que a empresa constrói carros de corrida com aprovação nas estradas.

programme.title: Episodio 17

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres

programme.title: Episodio 8

programme.title: Episodio 9
programme.desc: Yubiri le reclama airadamente a Briggite el robo de su logo. Y le dice que también la había admirado mucho. Cuando escuchó esto Briggite | pensó que ahora si la podía fregar. programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Adolfo y Rodrigo conspiran para destruir la empresa de los Ferrándiz. Carlos Ernesto se opone al encuentro entre Jimena y Adolfo, él piensa que Adolfo trama algo para perjudicarlos. Alejandra manda a Carlota a espiar a la casa de los Ferrándiz bajo el disfraz de la enfermera de Trinidad. Adolfo convence a Jimena de que las sospechas de sus hijos son infundadas y vuelve a ocupar su cargo en la empresa. Rodrigo irrumpe en la casa de Virginia.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.desc: The Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog 24/7

programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Cyboars
programme.desc: Part Machine, Part Boar, All Hero!

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Jogos de Inventar
programme.desc: Um espaço em branco é preenchido com cores, sons e movimentos, de acordo com a imaginação de Juju, Miro, Quique, Shay, Migui e Dodó, que inventam jogos ao desvendar um livro muito divertido.

programme.title: Bernard
programme.desc: Siga Bernard enquanto ele faz uma bagunça!

programme.title: Jogos de Inventar
programme.desc: Um espaço em branco é preenchido com cores, sons e movimentos, de acordo com a imaginação de Juju, Miro, Quique, Shay, Migui e Dodó, que inventam jogos ao desvendar um livro muito divertido.

programme.title: O Som da Música
programme.desc: Em “O Som da Música”, Jacarelvis e seus amigos apresentam as características e sons de diversos instrumentos musicais pertencentes a diferentes culturas. Cada episódio é dedicado a algum instrumento específico, onde são apresentados brevemente a história, os atributos e funcionamento de instrumentos como o violão, o xilofone, a gaita, piano, flauta, entre outros. E a festa sonora fica por conta de Jacarelvis e seus amigos, que apresentam as suas habilidades musicais com cada um dos instrumentos.

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Viaje para um mundo mágico onde o simpático Mago das Formas revela os segredos dos desenhos! Em cada episódio, três novos desenhos são criados usando formas geométricas básicas e elementos surpresa. Desafios de atenção e curiosidades tornam essa série divertida e educativa, ensinando o conceito de desenho por meio de formas geométricas. Divirta-se e aprenda com o Mago das Formas!

programme.title: Jacarevis e Amigos
programme.desc: Prepare-se para cantar, dançar e aprender! No Volume 01, Jacarelvis e sua turma misturam rock, reggae, blues e até bossa-nova para transformar o dia a dia das crianças em música e diversão. Entre abelhinhas parceiras, escovação de dentes, frutas, bichinhos de estimação e até lições sobre arrumar a bagunça, cada clipe traz humor, energia e muito aprendizado em ritmo animado!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Eles podem ser chamados de Curtas, mas com eles a diversão não é nada curta. Junte-se às sensações mundiais, Talking Tom and Friends, nessa série ágil e divertida, onde os seus jogos preferidos ganham vida diante dos seus olhos! Veja as aventuras hilariantes deles e prepare-se para sorrir sem parar!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: O Talking Hank mal pode esperar por seu primeiro dia de trabalho como segurança na Noite dos Nerds que será realizada na cidade, mas o trabalho acaba não tendo tanta ação quanto ele esperava.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: A Sra. Vanthrax pega um resfriado e pede ao Talking Ben para ser seu professor substituto. O Ben fica eufórico, principalmente porque hoje a classe vai decidir sobre um projeto para a feira de ciências!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: Como prefeito, o Talking Tom precisa ir a uma festa de gala beneficente na cidade. Ele leva o Talking Ben e a Talking Angela com ele, pensando que eles vão conseguir se enturmar com todas aquelas pessoas chiques.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: O Talking Tom está com uma dor de dente terrível, mas não quer tratá-la porque tem medo de ir ao dentista! Ele deixa o Talking Hank hipnotizá-lo para perder o medo... e dá certo!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: Enquanto jogam bola na garagem, a Talking Angela e o Talking Ginger acabam quebrando, sem querer, a mais nova invenção do Talking Ben, o Nanolaser.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: Os amigos do Talking Tom o estão incomodando, mas ele tem um plano perfeito para fugir deles: trocar de lugar durante o dia com o “Tim”, um cara que é igualzinho a ele!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: O Talking Ginger está se sentindo excluído porque os amigos na garagem não querem fazer nenhuma coisa de criança... até que um creme antienvelhecimento experimental transforma todos eles em crianças!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: No aquário, Barry e sua família estão dançando junto com a família dos tubarões, balançando no ritmo submarino!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: Já passou da hora de dormir, mas Barry e Timmy — dois corujinhas famintos por açúcar — não resistem a pegar um monte de doces. Agora, com os dedos grudentos e os olhos arregalados, eles rolam na cama sem conseguir dormir.

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: As rodas do ônibus giram sem parar, e Barry e Timmy se perguntam — para onde essa viagem mágica vai levá-los?

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: Uma melodia alegre flutua pelo ar, enquanto Barry chama Timmy: “Hora de acordar, amigão!” Juntos, vão começar o dia com grandes sorrisos e aventuras ainda maiores!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: No coração da floresta, há um macaquinho sapeca que está sempre aprontando. Barry e Timmy sabem que ele tem uma verdadeira obsessão por bananas e maçãs vermelhas suculentas — e não conseguem parar de rir quando ele aparece procurando seu próximo lanchinho!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: Cinco macaquinhos sapecas estão pulando por toda parte, e Barry e Timmy estão começando a entrar em pânico, torcendo para não acabarem em uma encrenca danada!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: Barry e Timmy olham para o relógio, com os olhos arregalados — já está na hora!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: A chuva está caindo forte, mas Barry mal pode esperar para pular nas poças. Enquanto isso, Timmy encara o céu cinza, cruzando os dedos para o sol voltar logo.

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: O cordeirinho está berrando por ajuda, e Barry e Timmy estão prontos para dar uma mão, tosando juntos sua lã fofinha!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: A pequena aranha corajosa, sem medo do vento ou da chuva, sobe até o telhado. Barry e Timmy observam admirados enquanto ela alcança o topo e se estica para pegar um solzinho — como uma verdadeira aventureira vencendo o desafio!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: A estrelinha brilhava forte, guiando os irmãos Barry e Timmy pela noite até encontrarem o caminho de casa!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.sub-title: Desejamos a Voce um Feliz Natal
programme.desc: No Dia de Natal, a família de Barry está envolvida na magia da temporada, curtindo o calorzinho aconchegante e a alegria festiva que preenche o ar!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: Água quente pode ser bem perigosa! Barry e Timmy estão sempre de olho para garantir que ninguém se aproxime demais da “fera fervente”. Eles estão aqui para lembrar: Cuidado! Queimar-se não é brincadeira!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: Venha contar junto com Barry e Timmy os patinhos sapecas que estão causando a maior confusão!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: Barry e Timmy têm um amiguinho adorável em casa – o cachorrinho Bingo, e ele é a bolinha de pelos mais fofa de todas!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: Na fazenda, há um montão de animais, e Barry e Timmy decidiram fazer uma visita bem divertida a todos eles!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: A Irmã Tigre e seus pais, junto com Barry e Timmy, estão jogando pique-esconde na fazenda, onde cada celeiro, monte de feno e árvore esconde uma nova surpresa!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: Barry e Timmy embarcaram em uma aventura selvagem, descobrindo várias partes do corpo na música super animada “A Canção das Partes do Corpo”!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.sub-title: A Ponte de Londres Vai Cair
programme.desc: “Faça como eu!” diz a professora do jardim com um sorrisão, girando e rodopiando. Barry e Timmy caem na risada e começam a dançar, imitando cada movimento dela!

programme.title: BarryTiger(Brazilian Portuguese)
programme.desc: O parque de diversões é pura alegria, e Barry e Timmy estão se divertindo como nunca, andando nas montanhas-russas mais radicais e jogando todos os jogos possíveis!

programme.title: Peixonauta
programme.desc: A Agencia Secreta O.S.T.R.A. enviou algumas pistas interessantes para nossos heróis. Agora eles tem uma missão, e acreditam que possa ser sobre um filhote perdido que precisa de ajuda para voltar pra casa. Com a participação de Rosa, Chumbo Feliz e dos gêmeos, eles partem para a investigação e aprendem como diferentes animais cuidam de suas crias. Quando a missão é cumprida acontece uma grande festa a fantasia para comemorar!

programme.title: Peixonauta
programme.desc: Peixonauta, Marina e Zico descobrem uma trilha de gosma no Parque. O que poderia ser? Durante a jornada para solucionar o mistério eles percebem que os visitantes estão tirando algumas árvores e arbustos da beira do lago criando assim um espaço maior para colocarem suas canoas, mas não percebem o efeito ruim que esta erosão traz para o lago. Para ajudar a água a ficar limpa novamente, todos ajudam a replantar as margens.

programme.title: Peixonauta
programme.desc: Peixonauta e Marina estão se divertindo imitando os sons dos pássaros quando, de repente, escutam um som de buzina muito esquisito! Eles pedem a ajuda de Zico para descobrir que barulho é aquele, mas o macaco anda nervoso e um tanto estranho... Será que o Zico está escondendo alguma coisa? Durante a procura, eles conhecem um ganso canadense e aprendem sobre seus hábitos e sobre sua sua migração.

programme.title: Peixonauta
programme.sub-title: O Caso da Troca de Identidades
programme.desc: O Dr. Jardim deu uma lista de diversos tipos de animais para sua netinha Marina e pediu sua ajuda para encontrá-los no Parque, mas ela está preocupada pois não consegue achar vários deles! Com a ajuda das pistas da POP, Peixonauta, Marina e Zico descobrem muitas criaturas que se escondem da gente, bem em baixo dos nossos olhos!

programme.title: Peixonauta
programme.desc: Um cheiro esquisito está incomodando todos os habitantes do Parque. Ainda bem que a POP traz algumas pistas que ajudam nossos companheiros a encontrar um grupo de jovens acampando no Parque. O grupo está deixando os restos de frutas e vegetais pelo chão, achando que a natureza se encarregará de dar um fim neles. Peixonauta, Marina e Zico mostram aos novos amigos como transformar aquele lixo em adubo, que ajuda no crescimento e fortalecimento de árvores e flores.

programme.title: Peixonauta
programme.desc: Peixonauta e Rosa percebem um arco-íris na superfície do lago, e ele está se espalhando rapidamente pelas águas! Eles descobrem que o arco-íris é, na verdade, uma mancha de óleo. Com a ajuda das pistas da POP, da Marina e do Zico, eles começam uma investigação para descobrir de onde este óleo está vindo. Durante a procura, aprendem maneiras de limpar a sujeira causada pelo vazamento de óleo e como prevenir que isto aconteça.

programme.title: Peixonauta
programme.desc: Peixonauta, na água, e Zico, na terra, brincam com seus novos amiguinhos: girinos e lagartas. Depois que a brincadeira acaba, as criaturas desaparecem repentinamente! O que está acontecendo no Parque das Árvores Felizes? Peixonauta e sua turma começam a investigar as pistas da POP, e descobrem que seus novos amiguinhos não desapareceram, eles apenas cresceram!

programme.title: Peixonauta
programme.sub-title: O Caso da Bagunca das Marmotas
programme.desc: Parece ser mais um dia normal no Parque, mas de repente, marmotas começam a correr assustadas por todos os cantos! Elas incomodam todo mundo com a confusão que estão causando á procura de novos lares. Mas porque elas estão querendo um lugar novo para morar? Peixonauta e seus amigos desvendam as pistas da POP e descobrem que a grande bagunça foi causada por Pedro e Juca. Envergonhados pelo que causaram, eles ajudam as marmotas a, finalmente, voltarem para suas casas em túneis subterrâneos.

programme.desc: Jacarelvis e seus amigos descobrem o som do fonema B enquanto exploram palavras como biscoito, bochecha, bule, e banana. Diversão e aprendizado garantidos em apenas um minuto!

programme.title: Sopa de Letrinhas
programme.desc: Jacarelvis e seus amigos aprendem o som do fonema N, explorando palavras como nariz, neném e ninho. Com sons como "ná", "né", "ni", "nó" e "nu", eles embarcam em uma aventura noturna com nuvens e navios, tornando o aprendizado encantador em apenas um minuto!

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: De quantas formas conseguimos pintar um elefante? Depois, vamos ouvir o divertido som da TUBA. Já, já, jacaré! Vamos ouvir fonemas da letra “J”! E pra terminar, vamos ao mercado cantar a história de uma determinada Formiguinha!

programme.title: Sopa de Letrinhas
programme.desc: Jacarelvis e seus amigos exploram o som do fonema R, aprendendo palavras como rato, relógio e robô. Repetindo sons como "rá", "ré", "ri", "ró" e "ru", eles criam histórias envolventes com robôs e ratinhos relaxando, tornando o aprendizado uma aventura divertida em apenas um minuto!

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: Vamos descobrir o o que será montado com os bloquinhos mágicos. Depois, batucar aprendendo o SOM DA BATERIA. No teatrinho a Tatá tenta descobrir quem está roubando seus biscoitos e pra terminar, muito rock com a música BANHO EU VOU TOMAR!

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: O Jacarelvis começa vestindo uma fantasia MÁGICA! Depois, conheceremos a gostosa melodia da HARPA. O Mico-Tuco revela diversos animais marinhos com suas BOLHAS! Tá-té-ti-to-Tudo ótimo com os fonemas da letra “T” e pra terminar, a RODA DO ÔNIBUS do Jacarelvis!

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: O Mico-Tuco revela diversos brinquedos em suas BOLHAS! Pra agitar todo mundo, hoje o som é da SANFONA. Depois conhecem os Fonemas da letra “G”! Jacarelvis bate um bolão com a fantasia de hoje! E pra terminar, vamos querer FÉRIAS!

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: Vamos começar com as bolhas surpresa do Mico-Tuco na fazenda. Veja, que curioso, vamos conhecer o “Lápis de Violão”. Depois os fantoches contam a deliciosa história do Bolinho Vovó Jacarilda. E no fim, vamos cantar e subir pela parede com a Dona Aranha

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: Vamos começar montando bloquinhos de Gato e Rato. Continuamos com o gostoso som do UKULELE. Depois as crianças vão imitar o som dos animais e pra terminar, uma deliciosa festa junina aonde vamos BALANÇAR O VESTIDO!

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: Vamos começar fazendo um lindo desenho com a Mamãe! Logo depois, vamos conhecer o animado som do Trompete! O Mico-Tuco descobre vários pássaros estourando suas bolhas! E pra terminar, vamos cantar um BOM DIA com o Jacarelvis

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: O Mico-Tuco estoura bolhas com vários Instrumentos Musicais. Depois conheceremos o som do CONTRABAIXO. Ba, Be, Bi, Bo, Bu! Fonemas com a letra “B”! Depois o nosso amigo Sabonete canta sua canção seguido pelo Circo do Seu lobato!

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: Um episódio educativo em que o Jacarelvis e os seus amigos ensinam as cores e o som que faz o violão. Na parte do teatrinho o Béim, Béim brinca na chuva e para terminar uma canção pirata sobre o lixo.

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: Começamos com o Mico-Tuco revelando bichinhos fofinhos em suas bolhas. Depois ouviremos o gostoso som da Kalimba. Seguimos com Fonemas com a letra “F”. Manu fantoche toca pra gente o Xilofone. Pra fechar, vamos arrumar tudo ao som do Rock da Bagunça

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: Vamos estourar Bolhas com o Mico-Tuco no Espaço sideral. Depois vamos aprender o relaxante som do SAXOFONE. Uma gostosa música pra aprender a palavra BOLO. E hoje vai ter casamento, pois terminamos com a canção do Sapo Cururu

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: Começamos com uma curiosa Tinta de Piano! A seguir, aprendemos o som do PANDEIRO. Depois vamos mergulhar nos fonemas com a letra “M”. Mico-Tuco estoura bolhas num divertido Circo. E encerramos num show cantando “Pintinho Amarelinho”

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: Começamos com uma eletrizante corrida de bolinhas, depois vamos descobrir como faz o som da GAITA. No teatrinho o Jacarelvis consegue mudar de cor e para terminar, a canção do Mico-Tuco vai fazer cosquinha em você aí!

programme.title: Recreio do Jacarelvis

Ele cria um dragão, um alienígena e um robô usando formas geométricas como semicírculos, triângulos e trapézios. As crianças são levadas a uma aventura imaginativa através de diferentes histórias, aprendendo a desenhar criaturas fantásticas com formas básicas. Uma jornada criativa e educativa através do mundo dos livros!

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Neste episódio de "O Mago das Formas", o mago leva as crianças para um passeio de barco enquanto ensina a desenhar usando formas geométricas. Juntos, eles desenham um barco, um hipopótamo e um peixe, explorando formas como trapézios, triângulos e círculos. O episódio é repleto de curiosidades e diversão, estimulando a criatividade e o aprendizado das crianças.

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Neste episódio de "O Mago das Formas", o mago visita uma loja de instrumentos musicais e desenha um violão, uma bateria e um saxofone usando formas geométricas. Com ovais, retângulos, círculos e outras formas, as crianças aprendem a criar esses instrumentos enquanto descobrem mais sobre música. No final, o mago escolhe seu instrumento perfeito: o triângulo! Uma aventura musical e educativa que mistura arte e som.

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Neste episódio de "O Mago das Formas", o mago visita um museu para explorar formas geométricas na história. Ele desenha um dinossauro, um castelo e um rei usando retângulos, triângulos, semicírculos e outras formas. As crianças aprendem sobre o passado de maneira divertida e educativa, enquanto criam desenhos inspirados por descobertas históricas. Uma viagem fascinante pelo tempo através das formas!

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Neste episódio de "O Mago das Formas", o mago explora a floresta durante a noite para descobrir os animais noturnos. Usando formas geométricas, ele desenha uma raposa, uma aranha e um morcego. As crianças aprendem a criar esses animais com pentágonos, triângulos, círculos e outras formas, enquanto descobrem a vida noturna na floresta. Uma aventura mágica e educativa sob as estrelas!

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Neste episódio de "O Mago das Formas", o mago embarca em um trem e convida as crianças para um passeio pela mata. Durante a viagem, ele desenha uma locomotiva, um tucano e um coelho usando formas geométricas como quadrados, triângulos e círculos. As crianças aprendem a criar desenhos divertidos e a reconhecer diferentes formas enquanto exploram a estação de trem e a natureza ao redor.

In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: The Angry Planet team heads to Africa to climb the steep and very active Nyiragongo Volcano in the Congo that erupted in 2002, sending 125,000 people fleeing for their lives. Host/adventurer George Kourounis explores the bubbling lake of molten lava and investigates the risk the dangerous volcano poses to both the people of city of Goma and the Mountain Gorillas who live on the nearby jungle slopes.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: Angry Planet | The Winds of Autumn
programme.desc: The autumn of 2006 brings hurricanes to the North Atlantic and hot dry winds fan forest fires across Northern Ontario. Host/adventurer George Kourounis has traveled to some awesome hurricanes, including Rita and Katrina, with his pal Mark Robinson. This year they stormchase in Newfoundland, site of the hurricane that pulled Mark out of a life-threatening depression.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Host George Kourounis has braved many terrifying phenomena – but none as frightening as the one he takes on in this episode: marriage! To make sure his new bride is on the same adventurous page with him, he proposes to get married on the lip of an exploding volcano, on the South Pacific island of Tanna, in Vanuatu. Before the native preacher, dressed in grass skirt and kustom garb, gets to perform the smoky vows, George descends into the erupting volcano to bring out red hot samples of the lava it is producing.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Avalanche danger is very high in the Rogers Pass area of the Trans Canada Highway in British Columbia. Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains. Ski Patrollers throw hand charges to clear the slopes, the British Columbia Department of Highways uses helicopter bombing and mountaintop mortars to keep the roads safe, and the Canadian Armed Forces fire 105mm howitzers at the mountains to bring down the dangerous snow. Still, there are accidents and fatalities in the mountains. We meet Francois Desroisers, an avalanche burial victim who tells a terrible and tragic tale of a mountain disaster.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Some of the fiercest weather can be experienced at the area the South Americans call the “Fin del Mundo”.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George returns to “Tornado Alley” with 3 fellow stormchasers to see what the 2007 Storm Season will bring.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George experiences the most extreme climates in North America. First he visits the hottest place on the continent – Death Valley, then the coldest – Snag, Yukon.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: In the porous limestone of Canada’s West Coast, great forces are at work under the ground, building and eroding the underground into fantastic shapes. In this episode we’ll witness George’s explorations of these massive underground cave systems.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Stormchasing developed in Australia in the same period – the 1990s – as it developed in the American Midwest. In the first week of December – the height of storm season in Australia, we plan to travel with Jimmy Deguara, the most experienced of Australian stormchasers.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. Eastern flanks of the volcano to slip by up to two metres, and many houses on the flanks of the volcano experienced structural damage. The eruption also completely destroyed the Rifugio Sapienza, on the southern flank of the volcano. The Rifugio was the site of a cable car station which had previously been destroyed in the 1983 eruption; both have now been rebuilt. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: Angry Planet | By Camel to Timbuktu
programme.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. What better place to do it than this fabled city in the middle of the mighty Sahara Desert.This almost mythical place really does exist. And it really is still possible to travel there by camel caravan, riding the infamous “Ships of the Desert”. Extreme heat, dehydration, possible sand storms, frigid night temperatures and desert predators are our potential companions for the trip.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: No-one creates eco-disasters on quite the scale of the former Soviet Union. In Uzbekistan, the Aral Sea, once one of the largest freshwater lakes in the world, has seen its waters diverted, so that it has shrunk to 1/6 its previous size. In Crimea, a mountain has been carved into a james bondian submarine base. In northern Ukraine, the Chernobyl nuclear site has been reduced to a radioactive wasteland.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George returns to the “Fin Del Mundo” at the southern tip of Argentina, this time to sail on a Russian icebreaker to Antarctica. After braving the stormy Drake passage, he explores volcanic Deception Island, camps out in the Antarctic snow, and paddles a kayak through icebergs calved off the melting glaciers.
